entities.name: Mesrop Mashtots Monastery (Nasirvaz)
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: Mesrop Mashtots Monastery or St. Gr. Lusavorich Monastery was an Armenian monastery located in Nəsirvaz village of the Nakhchivan Autonomous Republic of Azerbaijan. The monastery was located in the western part of the village.
